title: Nook
summary: Lightweight web console for embedded Linux device management and IoT security.
description: Nook is a lightweight management and security console for embedded Linux, integrating system administration, file management, terminal access, network discovery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, hardware management, and security tools such as BadUSB and Wardriving. Accessible directly through a web browser, Nook simplifies device management and IoT security testing.
